name: shors-algorithm
description: Use this skill when the user says 'Shor's algorithm', 'quantum factoring', 'period finding', 'break RSA with quantum', 'order finding', 'discrete log quantum', 'how many qubits to break RSA-2048', 'Q-Day estimate'. Explains Shor's reduction from factoring to order finding, the quantum period-finding circuit (modular exponentiation + inverse QFT), classical post-processing with continued fractions, a runnable classical simulation of the logic, and realistic resource estimates for RSA/ECC. Do NOT use for: migration planning to PQC (quantum-computing/post-quantum-crypto), Grover search (quantum-computing/grovers-algorithm), or the QFT/phase-estimation survey (quantum-computing/quantum-algorithms).
